title: UniJev: Separating Accuracy from Calibration in Trimodal System One Decision Models
title_zh: UniJev：在三模态系统一决策模型中将准确率与校准分离

paragraphs.en: System One models produce probabilistic judgments that software can consume directly, making reliable confidence as important as answer accuracy. Yet joint training across text, images, and video remains underexplored, and the contributions of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD) are difficult to separate. We introduce UniJev , a trimodal framework that scores candidate answers with a shared head under joint supervised training across text, images, and video. Supervised decision models improve accuracy over their backbone readouts across all three modalities, while the existing RLCD algorithms change accuracy little and have inconsistent effects on visual calibration across recipes. These findings motivate a separate supervised objective for confidence calibration. We introduce CORA (Confidence–Outcome Reliability Alignment), which groups current predictions by confidence and optimizes each prediction’s confidence toward the empirical accuracy of its bin. At both 2B and 9B, CORA lowers image and video expected calibration error (ECE) while preserving accuracy, without a reinforcement stage. We release our code at https://github.com/wjnwjnwj/UniJev .
paragraphs.zh: System One 模型产生软件可直接消费的概率性判断，这使得可靠置信度与答案准确性同样重要。 然而，跨文本、图像和视频的联合训练仍探索不足，且监督微调（SFT）与用于校准决策的强化学习（RLCD）各自的贡献难以分离。 我们提出 UniJev，一个三模态框架，在文本、图像和视频的联合监督训练下，用共享头对候选答案进行评分。 监督式决策模型在所有三种模态上都比其骨干读出层提升了准确性，而现有的 RLCD 算法对准确性改变甚微，且在不同配方下对视觉校准的影响不一致。 这些发现促使我们为置信度校准设计一个独立的监督目标。 我们提出 CORA（置信度–结果可靠性对齐），它按置信度对当前预测分组，并将每个预测的置信度向其所属区间的经验准确性优化。 在 2B 和 9B 两种规模下，CORA 在保持准确性的同时降低了图像和视频的期望校准误差（ECE），且无需强化学习阶段。 我们在 https://github.com/wjnwjnwj/UniJev 发布了代码。

paragraphs.en: System One models turn language-conditioned requests into judgments that software can consume directly. Jev expresses these judgments through typed decisions and candidate probabilities ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . As the same workflow expands from documents to images and video, it requires both a capable decision model and reliable confidence.

paragraphs.en: Three challenges remain in developing a reliable training recipe. First, joint training across text, images, and video remains underexplored, with many decision models focused on text ( Laya contributors, 2026 ; Verdict contributors, 2026 ; Jared Palmer and Kev contributors, 2026 ) . Second, the respective contributions of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD) ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; Gao and Wang, 2026 ) remain unclear. Both stages update the same model, and some RLCD recipes combine reinforcement with additional supervision, making it difficult to attribute improvements to either component. Third, rewarding correct decisions does not by itself ensure reliable confidence, because calibration requires the reported probabilities to agree with empirical correctness across questions. Evaluating a training recipe therefore requires separate measurements of answer accuracy and confidence calibration. Figure 1 summarizes this distinction across the two training stages.
paragraphs.zh: 构建可靠的训练方案仍面临三个挑战。 首先，跨文本、图像和视频的联合训练仍探索不足，许多决策模型专注于文本（ Laya contributors, 2026 ; Verdict contributors, 2026 ; Jared Palmer and Kev contributors, 2026 ）。 其次，监督微调（SFT）与用于校准决策的强化学习（RLCD）（ TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; Gao and Wang, 2026 ）各自的贡献仍不明确。 这两个阶段更新的是同一个模型，并且一些 RLCD 方案将强化学习与额外的监督相结合，因此难以将改进归因于其中任何一个组件。 第三，奖励正确的决策本身并不能确保可靠的可信度，因为校准要求所报告的概率在各个问题上与经验上的正确性相一致。 因此，评估一个训练方案需要分别测量答案准确率和可信度校准。 图 1 总结了这两个训练阶段之间的这一区别。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we introduce UniJev , a trimodal decision model with separate training objectives for candidate selection and confidence calibration. Text, images, and video share a multimodal backbone and a head that scores the candidate answers, producing answer distributions without autoregressive decoding. Joint SFT trains candidate selection, followed by CORA (Confidence–Outcome Reliability Alignment) for calibration. CORA groups current predictions by confidence and uses each sufficiently populated bin’s empirical accuracy as a shared training target. The groups and targets are recomputed as the model changes, and inference uses the trained model’s probabilities directly.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 UniJev，这是一个三模态决策模型，为候选选择和置信度校准分别设置了训练目标。 文本、图像和视频共享一个多模态骨干网络以及一个为候选答案打分的输出头，无需自回归解码即可生成答案分布。 联合 SFT 先训练候选选择，随后进行 CORA（置信度—结果可靠性对齐）以实现校准。 CORA 按置信度对当前预测进行分组，并将每个样本数量足够多的区间的经验准确率作为共享训练目标。 分组和目标会随着模型的变化而重新计算，推理时直接使用训练后模型的概率。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate accuracy and calibration separately across text, image, and video. Comparisons cover general-purpose multimodal models, released decision models (including Jev, OneJev, and Valen), and local training controls. The local controls include SFT and reward-shaped RLCD (Shaped RLCD), as well as adaptations of GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , OpenJev-RLCD/ CtR ( Gao and Wang, 2026 ) , RLCD-lite ( RLCD-lite contributors, 2026 ) , and Rewarding Doubt ( Bani-Harouni et al., 2025 ) ; Appendix A specifies these recipes. On the common trimodal test suite, supervised decision models improve accuracy over backbone readouts, whereas the existing RLCD algorithms change accuracy little and have inconsistent effects on image and video calibration across recipes. These results support treating visual calibration as a distinct training objective rather than assuming it improves alongside accuracy. At both 2B and 9B, CORA reduces image and video ECE while preserving accuracy, without a reinforcement stage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分别在文本、图像和视频上评估准确率与校准。 对比对象涵盖通用多模态模型、已发布的决策模型（包括 Jev、OneJev 和 Valen），以及本地训练对照。 本地对照包括 SFT 和带奖励塑形的 RLCD（Shaped RLCD），以及对 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024）、OpenJev-RLCD/CtR（Gao and Wang, 2026）、RLCD-lite（RLCD-lite contributors, 2026）和 Rewarding Doubt（Bani-Harouni et al., 2025）的适配；附录 A 详述了这些配方。 在共同的三模态测试套件上，监督式决策模型相比骨干网络读出提升了准确率，而现有的 RLCD 算法对准确率改变甚微，且不同配方对图像和视频校准的影响不一致。 这些结果支持将视觉校准视为一个独立的训练目标，而不是假设它会随准确率一同提升。 在 2B 和 9B 两种规模下，CORA 均能降低图像和视频的 ECE，同时保持准确率，且无需强化学习阶段。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) a trimodal Jev-style model with a shared answer-scoring head and joint training across text, images, and video; (2) controlled trimodal comparisons showing substantial accuracy gains after the supervised decision-model conversion but small accuracy changes and inconsistent visual-calibration effects after the existing RLCD algorithms; and (3) CORA , a supervised calibration method that updates the model using current confidence-group accuracy and improves image and video calibration in our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：(1) 一个三模态 Jev 风格模型，具有共享的答案评分头，并在文本、图像和视频上进行联合训练；(2) 受控的三模态对比实验，显示在经过监督式决策模型转换后准确率大幅提升，而现有 RLCD 算法在转换后准确率变化较小且视觉校准效果不一致；(3) CORA，一种监督式校准方法，利用当前置信度分组的准确率来更新模型，并在我们的实验中改善了图像和视频的校准。

Text alternatives include encoder scoring (Laya, Verdict), option-conditioned attention (Jevlike), and pointer heads (Kev) ( Laya contributors, 2026 ; Verdict contributors, 2026 ; Jevlike contributors, 2026 ; Jared Palmer and Kev contributors, 2026 ) . Decider uses option-token logits; NanoJev and Shen et al.’s OpenJev model candidate interactions ( Decider contributors, 2026 ; NanoJev contributors, 2026 ; OpenJev contributors, 2026 ) . Vision extensions include Laya Vision, Dohnuts, MoJev, Vision-Jev, and decider-vision; OneJev and Valen support text, images, and video ( Laya Vision contributors, 2026 ; PsiACE, 2026 ; MoLeMo Lab, 2026 ; Vision-Jev contributors, 2026 ; Decider contributors, 2026 ; OmniJev, 2026 ; Valen contributors, 2026 ) . OmniJev combines decision heads with per-type calibration ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . UniJev studies joint trimodal training and confidence calibration through a shared answer-scoring head.

paragraphs.en: RLCD varies in reward, estimator, and supervision; Jev’s full recipe remains unpublished ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . Examples include perturbed proper-score rewards (Laya, Dohnuts), updates without a reference-model constraint (Astro-RLCD), categorical rewards (Eve-RLCD), clipped updates (Valen), paired Brier estimates (NanoJev), and actor–belief learning (Decider) ( Laya contributors, 2026 ; PsiACE, 2026 ; Astro-Han, 2026 ; Maio, 2026 ; Valen contributors, 2026 ; NanoJev contributors, 2026 ; Decider contributors, 2026 ) . REINFORCE-A mixes analytic and sampled gradients; OpenJev-RLCD calibrates before rationale reinforcement ( OpenJev contributors, 2026 ; Gao and Wang, 2026 ) . RLCR and Rewarding Doubt reward stated confidence ( Damani et al., 2025 ; Bani-Harouni et al., 2025 ) . Proper scoring rules support probability learning, but scores also reflect predictive resolution beyond calibration ( Brier, 1950 ; Gneiting and Raftery, 2007 ; Murphy, 1973 ; Vaicenavicius et al., 2019 ) . Post-hoc methods include sigmoid scaling, histogram binning, and Bayesian binning ( Platt, 2000 ; Zadrozny and Elkan, 2001 ; Naeini et al., 2015 ) ; calibration-error estimates depend on binning and sample size ( Kumar et al., 2019 ; Roelofs et al., 2022 ) . CORA uses current confidence-bin accuracy as detached supervision for the shared trimodal model, recomputing targets during training rather than applying a histogram map at inference. paragraphs.en: The training mixture combines text decisions from Kev’s decision-v7 collection ( Jared Palmer and Kev contributors, 2026 ) , image decisions from Valen-Training-General-100k ( Valen contributors, 2026 ) , and video multiple-choice questions from the JeV video collection. After source-group splitting, training contains 157,656 records, including 12,330 text, 98,142 image, and 47,184 video records. paragraphs.en: UniJev unifies text, images, and video through a shared System One decision interface. The supervised conversion improves accuracy across all three modalities, while the existing RLCD algorithms produce only small accuracy changes and inconsistent effects on visual calibration. CORA treats calibration as a separate supervised objective, aligning confidence with empirical correctness across questions while updating a shared model. At both 2B and 9B, it improves image and video calibration while preserving accuracy, without a reinforcement stage. These results support a division of labor between the two training stages. The supervised conversion provides the observed accuracy gains, while direct confidence-bin supervision improves visual calibration.

paragraphs.en: Our evidence for CORA ’s calibration benefit is limited to image and video decisions on the evaluated test suite and model scales. Group-accuracy targets include each question’s own outcome and may be noisy or transfer poorly beyond the training mixture. Calibration updates can also change the model’s answers. Local RLCD comparisons use a 2B backbone and one seed per recipe, limiting conclusions about small accuracy differences. Recipes that combine direct supervision with reinforcement do not isolate the contribution of the reinforcement stage. Released-model pretraining and source overlap are uncontrolled, and ECE alone establishes neither subgroup calibration nor useful confidence ranking. Our conclusions concern labeled, single-step decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们关于 CORA 校准收益的证据仅限于所评估测试套件和模型规模上的图像与视频决策。 群组准确率目标包含每个问题自身的结果，可能存在噪声，并且在训练混合分布之外可能迁移性较差。 校准更新也可能改变模型的答案。 局部 RLCD 比较使用 2B 主干且每种配方仅用一个随机种子，这限制了对较小准确率差异下结论的能力。 将直接监督与强化学习相结合的配方无法分离强化阶段的贡献。 已发布模型的预训练与数据源重叠均未受控，且仅凭 ECE 既不能确立子群组校准，也不能确立有用的置信度排序。 我们的结论针对的是有标签的单步决策。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation requires complete slices of 764 text, 1,858 image, and 502 video questions. Each model receives all candidates in the prescribed order. paragraphs.en: The local Shaped RLCD, GRPO, CtR, RLCD-lite, and Rewarding Doubt rows in Table 2 share the same 2B soft-label SFT checkpoint. Each continuation uses 500 steps on four GPUs with a global target of 32,768 input tokens per update. Shaped RLCD uses reward shaping with confidence-shaped action rewards; GRPO uses correctness rewards with group normalization. CtR adapts calibration-then-reinforcement to the categorical decision head with 250 steps of direct Brier calibration preceding 250 reinforcement steps, using the calibration checkpoint as reference. It therefore tests the two-stage recipe on candidate selection rather than reproducing the source’s rationale-generation experiments. RLCD-lite jointly samples an answer from the decision distribution and a stated confidence from an auxiliary five-level confidence question, rewarding correctness minus the squared confidence–correctness gap with a group-mean baseline and no reference-model constraint. Rewarding Doubt treats the proposed answer as fixed, asks an auxiliary eleven-level confidence question conditioned on that answer, and rewards the stated confidence’s log score with an exact categorical expected-reward baseline and a Kullback–Leibler (KL) penalty (weight 0.05) toward the initialization. Both adaptations update the shared model through the auxiliary confidence question; evaluation uses candidate probabilities, as for every row.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 中的本地 Shaped RLCD、GRPO、CtR、RLCD-lite 与 Rewarding Doubt 各行均共享同一个 2B 软标签 SFT 检查点。 每个续训过程使用 4 个 GPU 进行 500 步训练，每次更新的全局目标为 32,768 个输入 token。 Shaped RLCD 使用带置信度塑形动作奖励的奖励塑形；GRPO 使用带组归一化的正确性奖励。 CtR 将「先校准后强化」方法适配到分类决策头上，先进行 250 步直接 Brier 校准，再进行 250 步强化训练，并以校准检查点作为参考。 因此，它是在候选选择上检验这一两阶段配方，而非复现原文的理据生成实验。 RLCD-lite 同时从决策分布中采样一个答案，并从一个辅助的五级置信度问题中采样一个所陈述的置信度，奖励为正确性减去置信度与正确性之间差距的平方，使用组均值基线且无参考模型约束。 Rewarding Doubt 将所提出的答案视为固定，基于该答案提出一个辅助的十一级置信度问题，并以精确的分类期望奖励基线和朝向初始化的 Kullback–Leibler（KL）惩罚（权重 0.05）来奖励所陈述置信度的对数得分。 这两种适配方法均通过辅助置信度问题来更新共享模型；与其他所有行一样，评估使用候选概率。

paragraphs.en: We use the architecture in Section 3.1 , bfloat16 (BF16) backbone computation, 32-bit floating-point (FP32) scoring, and gradient checkpointing. The decision projections have dimension d = 256 d=256 ; low-rank adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2022 ) uses rank 32 and α = 64 \alpha=64 , trained together with the vision–language merger and decision head. The decision marker is the literal suffix Decision: , with its final token supplying the decision readout state; training uses token-budget batching and reshuffles candidate order across epochs. Inputs allow 32,768 tokens and up to 128 video frames, each capped at 65,536 pixels; over-length inputs are rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用第 3.1 节的架构，主干计算使用 bfloat16（BF16），评分使用 32 位浮点数（FP32），并启用梯度检查点。 决策投影的维度为 d = 256 d=256；低秩适应（LoRA）（Hu et al., 2022）使用秩 32 和 α = 64 \alpha=64，与视觉–语言合并器及决策头一同训练。 决策标记是字面后缀 Decision:，其最后一个 token 提供决策读出状态；训练采用 token 预算分批，并在各轮次之间重新打乱候选顺序。 输入允许 32,768 个 token 和最多 128 帧视频，每帧上限为 65,536 像素；超长输入将被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: CORA draws calibration groups from the trimodal SFT training set. AdamW uses no weight decay, head/LoRA/merger rates ( 2 × 10 − 5 , 5 × 10 − 6 , 10 − 6 ) (2\times 10^{-5},5\times 10^{-6},10^{-6}) , clipping at 1, seed 42, and a fixed budget of 100 updates on four GPUs. Each update groups 256 questions into 10 equal-width confidence bins with minimum support m = 20 m=20 ; intervals are left-closed and right-open except for the final interval, which includes confidence 1.0 1.0 . The reported model is the final checkpoint after 100 updates, without test-based checkpoint selection; test questions never contribute to training-bin statistics or gradients.
paragraphs.zh: CORA 从三模态 SFT 训练集中抽取校准分组。 AdamW 不使用权重衰减，头部/LoRA/合并器学习率分别为 (2×10⁻⁵, 5×10⁻⁶, 10⁻⁶)，梯度裁剪为 1，随机种子为 42，并在四块 GPU 上使用固定的 100 次更新预算。 每次更新将 256 个问题按等宽置信度分成 10 个置信度区间，每个区间的最小样本数为 m=20；除最后一个区间包含置信度 1.0 外，其余区间均为左闭右开。 所报告的模型是 100 次更新后的最终检查点，没有基于测试集的检查点选择；测试问题从不参与训练区间统计或梯度计算。

paragraphs.en: The calibration groups come from the SFT trimodal training set. For each optimizer update, compute the whole group’s current predictions, pool confidence and correctness across workers, and form detached bin-accuracy targets. To limit activation memory, collect statistics without gradients, then recompute each supported prediction at the same parameters and backpropagate its squared error. Update parameters once per group; the next group uses fresh outputs. If no bin reaches the minimum support, skip that optimizer update. Algorithm 1 specifies this order. At inference, return the trained model’s argmax and candidate probabilities directly.
paragraphs.zh: 校准组来自 SFT 三模态训练集。 对于每次优化器更新，计算整个组的当前预测，在多个工作节点间汇聚置信度与正确性，并形成分离的二桶准确率目标。 为限制激活内存，在无梯度情况下收集统计量，然后在相同参数下重新计算每个被支持的预测并反向传播其平方误差。 每组只更新一次参数；下一组使用新的输出。 如果没有任何二桶达到最小支持度，则跳过该次优化器更新。 算法 1 规定了这一顺序。 在推理时，直接返回训练后模型的 argmax 及候选概率。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 summarizes the completed 100-update run. The group loss decreases over training, while the supported fraction records how much of each group contributes to the calibration loss under the minimum-support rule. Periodic accuracy, Brier, and ECE measurements provide additional optimization diagnostics. paragraphs.en: For a single-token label, its score is the corresponding vocabulary logit at the answer position; probabilities are normalized over the candidate labels. If a tokenizer splits a label, we use its full conditional sequence log-likelihood and normalize over labels, rather than scoring only its first token. paragraphs.en: We organize 22 cases by modality, which include eight text (T1–T8), eight image (I1–I8), and six video (V1–V6), one compact sheet per modality. All cards compare Table 2 ’s soft-label 2B SFT initialization, the five 500-step RLCD continuations (Shaped RLCD, GRPO, RLCD-lite, Rewarding Doubt, and CtR), and the 100-update CORA model. Each card gives the input, candidates, annotation, and every model’s predicted answer with its confidence percentage. Display letters preserve candidate order; an asterisk marks an answer matching the annotation. CORA answers and confidence come from the same fixed-budget final checkpoint as Table 2 , matched by question identifier.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按模态组织 22 个案例，其中包括 8 个文本案例（T1–T8）、8 个图像案例（I1–I8）和 6 个视频案例（V1–V6），每种模态各有一张紧凑的汇总表。 所有卡片都比较了表 2 的软标签 2B SFT 初始化、五个 500 步的 RLCD 延续训练（Shaped RLCD、GRPO、RLCD-lite、Rewarding Doubt 和 CtR），以及经过 100 次更新的 CORA 模型。 每张卡片给出输入、候选答案、标注，以及每个模型的预测答案及其置信度百分比。 显示字母保持候选答案的顺序；星号标记与标注相符的答案。 CORA 的答案和置信度来自与表 2 相同的固定预算最终检查点，并按问题标识符进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: Figures 7 , 8 , 9 , and 10 give per-bin reliability diagrams for every row of Table 2 , in the same order and grouping as the table. In each panel the horizontal axis spans 15 equal-width confidence bins; the colored bars give the empirical accuracy of the predictions inside each bin, the light gray bars give each bin’s share of the slice’s predictions, and the dashed diagonal marks perfect calibration, where bin accuracy equals bin confidence. Bars above the diagonal indicate underconfidence in that bin, bars below it overconfidence; empty positions are bins that received no predictions. Modalities that a model does not support are marked in place, matching the dashes in Table 2 . Table 4 summarizes every distribution with four quantities per slice. The signed gap is between mean confidence and accuracy, the share of predictions is above 0.95 0.95 , the reliability (calibration) term of the binary Brier decomposition ( Murphy, 1973 ) is with 15 equal-width bins, and the AUROC of confidence is against answer correctness. AUROC measures whether confidence ranks correct predictions above errors; it does not measure agreement between confidence values and empirical accuracy. Every displayed number is computed from the saved prediction files by the profile-rendering script, and each recomputed accuracy is checked against the corresponding Table 2 cell.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7、图 8、图 9 和图 10 按与表 2 相同的顺序和分组，为表 2 的每一行给出按置信度分箱的可靠性图。 在每个子图中，横轴覆盖 15 个等宽的置信度分箱；彩色柱表示每个分箱内预测的经验准确率，浅灰色柱表示每个分箱占该切片预测的比例，虚线对角线表示完美校准，即分箱准确率等于分箱置信度。 高于对角线的柱表示该分箱存在信心不足，低于对角线的柱表示信心过高；空白位置表示未收到任何预测的分箱。 模型不支持模态（Modality）时在相应位置标注，与表 2 中的破折号相对应。 表 4 用每个切片四项指标汇总了每个分布。 带符号的差值是平均置信度与准确率之差，预测比例是高于 0.95 0.95 的份额，可靠性（校准）项是二分类 Brier 分解（Murphy, 1973）中的该项，采用 15 个等宽分箱，置信度的 AUROC 则相对于答案正确性计算。 AUROC 衡量置信度是否将正确预测排在错误预测之上；它并不衡量置信度数值与经验准确率之间的一致程度。 所有展示的数值均由配置渲染脚本从保存的预测文件计算得出，且每个重新计算的准确率都与表 2 中对应的单元格进行了核对。

paragraphs.en: The three regimes described in Section 4.4 are directly visible among the locally trained rows of Figure 10 . SFT-softlabel concentrates its mass below 0.95 0.95 and sits above the diagonal at high confidence; on image, half of its predictions fall in [ 0.90 , 0.95 ) [0.90,0.95) where its empirical accuracy is 1.00 1.00 , so it is most underconfident exactly where it is most confident. The four reward-driven recipes pile nearly all mass into the top bin while the accuracy of that bin stays far below the diagonal, the per-bin picture behind their inflated reliability terms. CtR and CORA retain graded confidence profiles and AUROC close to soft-label SFT. Shaped RLCD and GRPO change AUROC by at most 0.014 0.014 , whereas Rewarding Doubt and RLCD-lite reduce image AUROC from 0.934 0.934 to 0.888 0.888 and 0.847 0.847 , respectively. Among the reference rows, the label-type contrast repeats at 9B (hard-label bins below the diagonal, soft-label bins above it in every modality), and the released models range from low top-label calibration error on this test suite (OneJev-9B) to nearly deterministic confidence (Gemma 4).
paragraphs.zh: 第4.4节所述的三种机制在图10的局部训练行中清晰可见。 SFT-softlabel 的概率质量集中在 0.95 0.95 以下，且在高置信度区间位于对角线上方；在图像上，其一半的预测落在 [ 0.90 , 0.95 ) [0.90,0.95) 区间，而该区间的经验准确率为 1.00 1.00，因此它恰恰在最有把握的地方最为置信不足。 四种奖励驱动的方案将几乎全部概率质量堆入最高区间，而该区间的准确率仍远低于对角线，这正是其可靠性项被夸大的分区间图景。 CtR 与 CORA 保持了有梯度的置信度分布，其 AUROC 接近软标签 SFT。 经过塑形的 RLCD 与 GRPO 最多使 AUROC 变化 0.014 0.014，而 Rewarding Doubt 与 RLCD-lite 则分别将图像 AUROC 从 0.934 0.934 降至 0.888 0.888 和 0.847 0.847。 在参考行中，标签类型的对比在 9B 上再次出现（在每个模态中，硬标签区间均低于对角线，软标签区间均高于对角线），而发布的模型在此测试套件上的表现从较低的顶部标签校准误差（OneJev-9B）到近乎确定的置信度（Gemma 4）不等。
